# Tansiqua (تنسيقة)

> AI-powered modest fashion outfit coordinator — build coordinated hijab outfits, get color suggestions, and try looks on your own photo.

Tansiqua helps Muslim women assemble complete modest outfits across 12 clothing categories. It suggests harmonious colors, generates photorealistic full-outfit previews, analyzes real photos to detect pieces and colors, and can render the outfit onto a user-provided portrait.

## Pages

- [Outfit Builder](/): Assemble a full coordinated outfit, get AI color suggestions, and generate a photo of the look.
- [Color Guide](/colors): Pick a garment color and skin tone to see matching hijab color recommendations.
